internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: What to Wear (Rocky Mountain) is the second boutique of its kind. The original store is located in Edwardsville, IL., the hometown of our owner, Jerri Roush. The first store was started by her sister, Jill Dorsey, more than 13 years ago. Jill and her team have found great success in the midwest and we wanted to bring the same concept to beautiful Colorado Springs! We strive to carefully select unique styles and brands so no matter your personal style we will have something for you at What to Wea
